question: How method of interaction does Frederica use with newly hired servants? If Frederica had continued to work, I was curious about how her interaction would have gone with servant Subaru at the time of arc two.
answer: It would have been the same interaction that she had with Petra, but Petra is outstandingly excellent, and outstandingly cute, so the handling after that would have been quite different. She's been the senior to many maids, so she'd have been properly polite. Subaru is fairly handy, too, so he wouldn't have been much trouble as a student.
